source.text: Have predominantly squamous cell histology for NSCLC

mappings.appliesTo: Part B and Safety Lead-In Part B

source.text: Must have disease with evidence of KRAS G12C mutation.
Part A: Greater than or equal to (≥)50 percent (%).
Must have measurable disease per RECIST v1.1.
Must have an ECOG performance status of 0 or 1.
Have a documented additional validated targetable oncogenic driver mutation or alteration in genes such as epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR)
Prior systemic therapy (chemotherapy, immunotherapy, targeted therapy, or biological therapy) for advanced or metastatic NSCLC.
Have known active central nervous system metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis.
